contract.initializer: public ChatContextWindow(history: [ModelMessage], context: [ModelMessage], prompt: String) throws
contract.current_turn: Preserve context and prompt completely. Reject instead of truncating them.
contract.history: Validate every original history message as chronological user/assistant pairs. Select only a contiguous suffix of whole pairs, newest first for fitting, returned in chronological order.
contract.mutation: No source history/context/prompt mutation, persistence, model call or App side effect.
contract.accounting: Counts cover returned ModelMessage.content UTF8 bytes, not serialized JSON, role names or instructions appended by other layers.
